title: Advances in the Worldline Approach to Quantum Field Theory: Strong Fields, Amplitudes and Gravity
summary: This thesis is devoted to the first-quantized approach to quantum field theory, commonly known as the 'Worldline Formalism'. It collects most of the works completed by the author during the PhD, illustrating the versatility and efficiency of this formalism across a broad range of physical contexts. The applications discussed fall into two broad categories: perturbative and non-perturbative analyses.
